_published_faq.name: How do I add Starbuzz for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Starbuzz for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.starbuzz.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Starbuzz for Claude MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starbuzz for Claude provides these MCP tools: get_credit_balance, get_instagram_engagement_rate, and get_youtube_engagement_rate.
